raw_block.rationale: Create a single OpenExempt terminal helper that gates rules by the solved available exemption systems, matches normalized asset types, handles uncapped and per-debtor limits, and emits either EC or EV native structure without artificial projection dependencies.

inputs.name: asset_descriptions
inputs.question: What are the exact current asset descriptions, excluding value narration, in source order?

inputs.name: asset_values
inputs.question: In the same order, what is each current asset's numeric dollar value?

inputs.name: asset_types
inputs.question: In the same order, what single normalized statutory property type describes each current asset?

inputs.name: debtor_count
inputs.question: How many current debtors jointly own the assets under the task's stated ownership assumptions?

inputs.name: output_family
inputs.question: Does the current native response schema require EC citation arrays or EV citation-and-claim-value records? Return EC or EV.

skill.intent: Build the current EC or EV asset-exemption answer from an aligned table of operative exemptions available to the current debtor.

outputs.description: The native EC or EV mapping keyed by the exact current asset descriptions.
outputs.name: answer

premises.name: rule_citations

origin.quote: The Debtor may claim property exemptions under Federal and Oregon statutes.

premises.question: Which literal operative exemption citation strings from systems available to the current debtor protect a current asset type or genuinely protect any property?

premises.name: rule_protected_types

origin.quote: The debtor's interest, not to exceed $400 in value, in any personal property.

premises.question: For each returned citation, what normalized current asset type does its operative text protect, using any only for a genuine any-property exemption?

premises.name: rule_base_caps

origin.quote: Consider each asset-exemption pair independently, without factoring in aggregate values across multiple assets.

premises.question: For each citation, what independently applicable base dollar cap applies before per-debtor multiplication, using -1 only for an uncapped exemption?

premises.name: rule_per_debtor

origin.quote: Subject to the limitation in subsection (b), this section shall apply separately with respect to each debtor in a joint case.

premises.question: For each citation, may the stated cap be claimed separately by each current debtor and combined in the same jointly owned asset?

fields.name: rule_citations
fields.question: Return literal public citation strings; exclude unavailable jurisdictions and non-operative election, definition, opt-out, or multiplier provisions.

fields.name: rule_protected_types
fields.question: Return one normalized protected type per citation, exactly matching the current asset-type vocabulary when applicable; use any only for genuine wildcard exemptions.

fields.name: rule_base_caps
fields.question: Return the independently applicable numeric base cap for each citation, including authorized wildcard additions; use -1 for an uncapped exemption.

fields.name: rule_per_debtor
fields.question: Return true only where each current debtor may claim and combine a separate copy of the stated cap in the same jointly owned asset.

reads.question: Using the current source's solved exemption-system eligibility and supplied statutes, return one aligned table containing only operative exemptions available to the current debtor and relevant to a current normalized asset type or genuinely applicable to any property.

origin.quote: The Debtor may claim property exemptions under Federal and Oregon statutes.

source_obligations.statement: Evaluate assets only under exemption systems that the current solved source makes available to the debtor.

origin.quote: Consider each asset-exemption pair independently, without factoring in aggregate values across multiple assets.

source_obligations.statement: Apply each asset-exemption pair independently without consuming aggregate value on other assets.

origin.quote: Return only a JSON object: keys are the actual asset descriptions in Facts; values are arrays of all applicable public citation label IDs from the supplied vocabulary, or [] if none.

source_obligations.statement: Use the actual asset descriptions from Facts as output keys without appending values or surrounding narration.

origin.quote: For each asset in the estate, identify all applicable exemptions under which that asset may be protected, and determine how much of the asset's dollar value can be claimed under each exemption.

source_obligations.statement: For EV output, claim the lesser of the asset value and independently available cap; an uncapped exemption reaches the asset's full value.
